title: $L^2$-stability for the variance Brascamp-Lieb inequality
summary: We prove an $L^2$-stability estimate for the variance Brascamp-Lieb inequality [J. Funct. Anal. 22 (4), 366-389 (1976)] by bootstrapping the recent $L^1$-stability theorem of Machado and Ramos [arXiv:2511.22636] under an additional assumption, which we call the super-Brascamp-Lieb inequality, of independent interest.
